description: This PHP class 'Task' extends the Crunz Event class and represents a scheduled task within the OrangeHRM system's console scheduling framework. It manages the execution of console commands, handles errors via logging, and provides access to command information.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A scheduled task that executes a console command within the OrangeHRM framework, managing execution flow and error logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Task with an ID, command info, console, and output interface, setting up the command to run.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the console command associated with this task, returning an exit code, and logs errors if exceptions occur.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the CommandInfo object associated with this task.
